collection.title: Jeep Compass 2017 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Jeep Compass 2017 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Compass, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
